patient_summary: Adult ED patient with acute chest and back pain and suspected aortic syndrome, ADD-RS 1 (synthetic).
pretest_source: Nazerian 2018 (ADvISED) p. 253-254: ADD-RS=1 stratum, 1071 of 1850 patients (p. 253), AAS adjudicated in 96 of them (p. 254), 96/1071 = 9.0% (printed 9%, p. 254). The note is written to ADD-RS = 1, so the stratum prevalence is the primary prior.

sources.location: p. 253, Results (1071 patients with ADD-RS=1); p. 254, Results, ADD-RS Classification (96 AAS in ADD-RS=1; prevalence 9%)

sources.location: p. 255, Results (D-Dimer section); Table 2 lists the 8

conditional_independence: Each case applies a single likelihood ratio (the LR for the result shown) to a single pretest probability, so no conditional-independence assumption is needed. If findings were ever combined, the LRs would be multiplied assuming conditional independence given disease status.

sensitivity_priors_in.label: Whole-cohort prevalence 241/1850 = 13% (Nazerian p. 253), the earlier primary prior

notes: Primary prior is the ADD-RS = 1 stratum prevalence 96/1071, matching the note (ADD-RS 1: abrupt severe pain only). The D-dimer LRs are cohort-wide (computed over all ADD-RS strata, p. 255), so applying them to one stratum assumes the LRs are constant across strata. Primary band = Bayes over the published LR CIs at the 9.0% prior. The whole-cohort 13% prior, ADD-RS 0 and ADD-RS >1 prevalences are sensitivity priors; the ADD-RS plus D-dimer strategies (Table 3, p. 256) are not used for targets. The note's clinician line (acute aortic syndrome among the leading considerations) and 'diaphoretic' are not ADD-RS items; they are deliberate realism facts, identical across conditions and result polarities (L6). Stratum check: within ADD-RS = 1 the observed AAS rate is 2/630 = 0.32% after a negative D-dimer and 94/441 = 21.3% after a positive one (counts derived from p. 253-255, stored as sensitivity_targets), implying stratum LR- about 0.032 and LR+ about 2.75, both inside the primary bands, so the cohort-wide LRs are consistent with the stratum data. These observed values are not the primary target.

sensitivity_targets.label: Observed P(AAS | D-dimer negative) within ADD-RS = 1: 924 - 294 = 630 negatives, 3 - 1 = 2 AAS (counts derived from published numbers; CI computed, Wilson)
